meaning:
ἀθανασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀ-θάνατος, undying; V. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Wis.3:4 4:1 8:13,17 15:3, 4Ma.14:5 16:13 * ;]
immortality: 1Co.15:53,54 1Ti.6:16 (cf. Cremer, 285 f.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
